
Skills are Worklode-distributed and Worklode-recommended. Discovery is server-side selection (search plus pins) with deterministic delivery (task brief plus local files). Machinery finds and fetches; the model only judges whether an offered skill is relevant. Skills are never registered in any native skill registry and cost no per-skill description in session context. Any agent that can read a file participates: activation is reading a `SKILL.md` from the local store (§7.3).
